stop: Stop after the stage-2 evaluation of the cfcap-models-b1 n6 models on generator cal 0-1999, test 0-1999, H3/H4 0-499 (end-to-end timing) and, once role stress's T2 test episodes exist, the T2 evaluation of st-n6-1.
_doc: Role models, review round 0 fix 5. PREREQUISITES: (1) cfcap-models-b1 outputs pulled to ~/.cache/vast-out; then `$PY scripts/models_export.py ~/.cache/vast-out/<b1 dirs> --stage-weights $CFCAP_OUT/compute/stage2/models-b1-weights` (manifest + weights.pt per grid entry, ~4 MB each). (2) For models-t2 only: stress's T2 simulate outputs at $CFCAP_OUT/compute/stage2/b1-t2eps, and $CFCAP_OUT/compute/stage2/models-t2-pred = weights.pt of st-n6-1 + calib.json (results/models/calib/calib_st-n6-1.json written by models_export from the models-eval2 cal rows; T1 cal only). models-eval2: task cfcap/models/eval2.py:TASK regenerates the generator episodes by (plate, split, index) (same eids as gen-ref2 shards and the baselines' rows), runs the 6 n6 models (st x3 seeds, bb, ds, stl) with batch-1 synchronised timing per episode (sec_direct), and for st-n6-1 the compositional route for every candidate of every episode (sec_comp = posterior + rollouts, end to end per decision). The export then writes dec_models.csv.gz (seconds = end-to-end), latency_models.csv (end_to_end = 1) and the calib JSONs. Matched-compute SMC and capxfer on the same eids are the baselines role's (cfcap-b1 smc groups). unit_s ESTIMATES: 50 episodes per unit, ~10 s generation, 6 x 5 ms direct, ~1.0 s/episode composition (20 candidates x S 16 x 10 legs = 3.2k leg trials at the generator's 3.8k leg-trials/s) -> ~65 s (H4 ~3x); 100 units -> 10 shards x 10 units x 90 s mean. models-t2: 4000 T2 test episodes x ~1.2 s (direct + composition of self/children; merges refused: only the parent's T2 observation exists).
